title: Beautiful cover.. truthfully, it needs more inside!
text:
Beautiful cover.. truthfully, it needs more inside!. A beautiful linen cover that’s surprisingly far softer than ever expected.. I love the outer edges are left raw and frayed- It gives this a real unique almost rustic or, shabby chić flare of character..

The quality craftsmanship is there with a traight, clean finished seams.. Zipper is actually located on the upper back side vs. hidden inside the end seam as usual. I mention in case this bothers anyone it’s in plain sight.. for myself, it was a non issue. Zipper mechanics are functional- easy open/close.. no loose/unfinished strings to tangle on the interior side. (a problem I’ve encountered with many other pillow covers!)

The compressed insert will take shape as its released from the air tight sleeve. My issues with this pillow come in the amount of fill one actually receives.. its simply not enough! After waiting 48hr for insert to reach its expected size/shape in expansion- there wasn’t even enough to fill up all the empty space inside the cover. Sold at a higher price.. I expect filling to be in a large/solid enough quantity.. especially at $51 price point!

Don’t get me wrong.. this is beautiful! When put together and set nicely on the couch it’s fine for visual aesthetic’s- it looks nice. Problem is, this insert easily flattens under any weight as the stuffing doesn’t stay firm but rather smashes into the “left over empty space..” all bc, the the insert isn’t met with a snug exterior shell- my plan to fix this is ordering a more robust insert.. Something that shouldn’t if paying $51.

Overall, a beautiful accent pillow- it just needs problem rectified with insert for the price. Hoping this info helps your decision.. stay safe everyone!
